user_story: As a user, I want to assign a category to a task so that I can organize my tasks.

positive.title: Assign a category to a task
steps: Navigate to the task management application.
Select a task from the task list.
Select a category from the dropdown list.
positive.expected_result: The selected category is assigned to the task successfully and is displayed next to the task name.

negative.title: Attempt to assign a category to a task without selecting a category
steps: Navigate to the task management application.
Select a task from the task list.
Do not select any category from the dropdown list.
negative.expected_result: An error message 'Please select a category' is displayed and no category is assigned to the task.

edge.title: Assign a very long category name to a task
steps: Navigate to the task management application.
Select a task from the task list.
Input a category with 255 characters into the category name field.
edge.expected_result: The task accepts the category with a very long name if within limits and displays it without issues. If the length exceeds system limits, an error message is shown.
